result.summary: Splits the monolithic `test_IsStandard` unit test into independent test cases for each policy rule. Replaces mutable global policy settings (`g_dust`, `g_bare_multi`) with an explicit `StandardPolicy` struct passed into each check so test cases do not mutate state for subsequent checks.
result.problem: In `test_IsStandard`, test checks reuse transaction state and rely on mutable global variables to test non-default policy limits, coupling independent test assertions and risking state leakage between checks.
evidence: Part of tracking issue #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data')
Removes global variables `g_dust` and `g_bare_multi` in favor of per-case structs to ensure 'no case changes policy for another' (PR description)
result.scope_notes: A mechanical test refactor within a single unit test file, replacing stateful test sequencing with independent transaction builders.
result.card: Splits the monolithic test_IsStandard unit test into independent test cases per policy rule. It eliminates mutable globals like g_dust and g_bare_multi in favor of an explicit StandardPolicy struct passed per check, preventing state leakage across test assertions. This is a developer-facing test cleanup supporting issue #36692 with no functional node changes.

risk.why: A mistake could weaken unit test coverage for transaction standardness policy checks.
